title: Hypothesis: Is Dura Mater the True Culprit Behind Chiari 1 Malformations?
content: In this article, we discuss the theory that an error in dural development and/or signaling is responsible for the occurrence of Chiari 1 Malformations (CM1). Other widely accepted theories such as the premature closure of the spheno-occipital synchondrosis, or the paraxial mesodermal defect during embryogenesis are discussed, along with the most relevant evidence to substantiate our hypothesis.
